evidence.section_title: The Efficacy of Cognitive-Behavioral and Interpersonal Treatments for Depression in Puerto Rican Adolescents
evidence.quote: [page/0/Text/5] This study evaluated the efficacy of cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) and interpersonal psychotherapy (IPX) with depressed adolescents in Puerto Rico.
[/page/1/Text/11] Participants were randomly assigned to one of three conditions: CBT, IPT, or a wait-list control group.
[page/1/Text/15] Most of the participants met the criteria for double depression: 21 in IPT, 16 in CBT, and 17 in the wait-list control group.
